caption: the holiday week in the sky: a full moon, mercury into capricorn, and a little fog. dec 22 – 27, 2026.

slides.headline: the *holiday* week in the sky, before the family asks
full moon in *cancer*: the feelings arrive early
slides.body: the last full moon of 2026. reads as home, family and the person you miss.

slides.headline: the *sun* squares neptune: rose-tinted, slightly
slides.body: nostalgia is loud. an ex may look better than they were. check the facts.

slides.headline: *mercury* trines jupiter: the good talk at the table
slides.body: same day, kinder energy. a good evening for a generous conversation.

slides.headline: *mercury* enters capricorn on christmas day
slides.body: words get shorter and more serious. good for plans, bad for small talk.

slides.headline: *mercury* squares neptune: re-read before you send
slides.body: messages blur. the boxing day text can wait until it makes sense.

slides.headline: the one to watch: the *full moon*, wednesday
slides.body: plan the conversation, not just the dinner.
